headline: PICK RUSH ships labelled Plaicraft episodes — your shifts are now training data
lede: Every shift you play on the gantry now banks as a labelled grasp-and-place episode: seed, both cranes' pads, checkpoint hashes, and a hit/miss verdict on every drop, written by the same judging law that scores the run. A REC beacon blinks while your take is kept, the game-over card counts hits and misses, and npm run pickrush-export turns the line into a replay-verified corpus — 20 seeds, 4461 labelled drops, every episode replayed against the sim hash-exact before it counts.

notes.text: PR #2737 (issue #2734, never-dry stage): live takes bank through the Plaicraft kit with the sim's own labels; harness drives never bank; takes leave the phone only through an explicit export.

Durable catch: a pad stream carries pads, not RNG draws — the autopilot's seeded jitter paces the spawns, so capturing with it replays a respawned line. The corpus brain is now RNG-free by law, and a gate counts the draws to hold it.

pickcheck grew 9 EXPORT gate types plus browser REC gates: 93/93 node, 34/34 browser, and PICK_MUT=rec — a lying label law — reddens 9 named gates while replay stays green. 20/20 contracts completed, replay-verified ALL.

qa #2739 filed for the QA lane: crane inertia, stacked bin interiors, the first-shift feather lesson, a take-replay hook, drop-audio variety, and an attract rotation that actually shows the three risk laws.
